title: First, Next and Last
short: Who is first, next and last in line.

blocks.html: The animals are waiting in line at the door. The first one is right by the door. The last one is at the very end. Who is next?

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Who is first? Who is last?

blocks.html: First is at the front. Last is at the end. Next comes right after.

For the grown-up: Line up toys for a parade and ask who is first, next and last. Use these words through the day: “First we wash hands, next we eat, last we clean up.” Stop while it is still fun. Then go and play the real-life version.

items: Try it at home: Line up toys for a parade.
Say first, next and last as you get dressed.
Take turns being first in line.
